item.title: 2026-09-17 — Sep 17, 2026
item.description: First: Google opened Home MCP so any capable agent can talk to devices, history, cameras, dashboards. They ban some sensitive moves like unlocking doors, and still warn agents can do unexpected stuff. Steal the pattern for your platform tools — don't just allowlist "safe" calls.

item.title: 2026-09-13 — Sep 13, 2026
item.description: First: Salesforce-flavored research on co-evolving models and harnesses. Once the harness is already good, training a smaller model on expert trajectories can actually hurt. So don't casually retrain over a working outer loop. Freeze or version the harness when you change models.
